2608.23892.title: A Mathematical Theory of Interpretation: Rational Entropy, Spectral Readout, and Confusability as a Resource
2608.23892.paper_summary: This article presents the abridged core of \emph{A Mathematical Theory of Interpretation} (MTI), which treats interpretation as observer-relative spectral measurement under an access structure. MTI makes interpretation a method-design problem: access, query, utility, and medium determine what an observer can select, identify, communicate, or refuse. On a learning-invariant Hilbert realization, Rational Entropy measures residual uncertainty across knowledge, utility, and medium. In the finite-effective regime, we classify its zero set. Pairwise confusability is equivalent to uniform atomic collapse, while a unique utility maximum can select one atom even when other zero-cost states remain non-atomic. This reverses the usual zero-error role of confusability: agreement in at least one observer direction excludes unresolved multi-atom readings, while the joint label preserves identification. The corresponding free-design capacity is the product of all but the smallest direction budget. A four-condition certificate characterizes sharp, decodable, medium-faithful, and order-independent readout on a finite commuting code sector and returns typed obstructions when those guarantees fail. Together, these results establish MTI as a theoretical basis for constructing interpretation methods with explicit access assumptions, guarantees, and failure modes.
2608.23892.paper_summary_zh: 這篇文章呈現了\emph{A Mathematical Theory of Interpretation} (MTI)的簡要核心，該理論將詮釋視為在一種訪問結構下的觀察者相對光譜測量。MTI使詮釋成為一個方法設計問題：訪問、查詢、效用和媒介決定了觀察者可以選擇、識別、傳達或拒絕的內容。在一個學習不變的希爾伯特實現中，理性熵測量知識、效用和媒介之間的剩餘不確定性。在有限有效範疇內，我們對其零集進行了分類。成對混淆等同於均勻原子崩潰，而唯一的效用最大值可以選擇一個原子，即使其他零成本狀態仍然保持非原子性。這顛覆了混淆的通常零錯誤角色：在至少一個觀察者方向上的一致性排除了未解決的多原子讀取，而聯合標籤則保留了識別。相應的自由設計容量是所有方向預算的乘積，除了最小的方向。四個條件證書特徵化了在有限的可交換代碼區域上進行尖銳、可解碼、媒介忠實和順序獨立的讀出，並在這些保證失效時返回類型阻礙。這些結果共同確立了MTI作為構建具有明確訪問假設、保證和失效模式的詮釋方法的理論基礎。
2608.23892.author: Blake Reynolds et.al.
